widgets_values:
# Four-panel H3 20260928-173220 / 四コマH3 20260928-173220

## Purpose / 目的
Convert a four-panel manga into a variable-duration video. No song or MV input is required. / 四コマ漫画を可変尺動画へ変換します。曲・MV入力は不要です。

## Run order / 実行順
1. Choose one four-panel manga image; select an API provider and enter its key on your own PC. / 四コマ漫画を1枚選び、利用するAPIのキーを自分のPCで入力します。
2. Analyze original panel order, cast and every line; review Japanese reading and estimated timing. / コマ順、人物、全台詞を解析し、読みと推定尺を確認します。
3. Generate one clean reference, then each speaking turn as a distinct H3 shot with bounded cause-directed retries. / 単一参照を作成し、1発話ごとの別カットをH3で生成・原因別に上限付き再試行します。
4. Join accepted clips, compose one full-length instrumental BGM with ACE-Step, inspect it, duck it under speech, add title/credit and save MP4. / 採用区間を連結後、ACE-Stepで全尺のインストBGMを1曲作曲・検査し、会話中だけ下げ、題名・クレジットを付けてMP4保存します。

## Requirements / 必要な環境
Install the three bundled custom-node packages, ComfyUI-PlagueKind-Nodes, compatible Triton, the four H3 files and ACE-Step checkpoint listed in models.json. / 同梱3ノード、ComfyUI-PlagueKind-Nodes、対応Triton、models.json記載のH3用4ファイルとACE-Stepモデルが必要です。
Models, API keys, source manga and generated videos are not bundled. / モデル、APIキー、元漫画、生成動画は同梱しません。

## Validation / 検証
The 2026-09-28 normal graph completed a six-segment 36-second MP4 without this restored BGM branch. Earlier 2026-09-20 GUI runs completed with the connected BGM branch. A separate 2026-09-28 GUI run completed ACE-Step composition, inspection, mixing and final MP4 save using the 36-second output. Their combination in this portable graph has not yet been run end-to-end. Slight generated text distortion is acceptable per user; story-changing text, wrong dialogue and clones are not. / 9/28の通常グラフはBGM経路なしで6区間36秒MP4を完走。9/20のGUI実行はBGM接続経路で完走し、9/28の別GUI実行ではその36秒動画を使った作曲・検査・合成・MP4保存も完走しました。この配布グラフとしての全工程は未実走です。軽度の生成文字崩れは許容しますが、意味を変える文字・台詞破綻・分身は未許容です。

widgets_values_named.text:
# Four-panel video workflow / 四コマ動画ワークフロー

Build and verify the reusable generation system. Each output video is validation evidence. / 正しい動画を作るシステムの構築・検証が目的です。出力動画は検証資料として扱います。

## Steps / 実行順
1. Load your manga page at the left input. / 左の画像入力で元の漫画を選びます。
2. Choose the API provider in the orange node and register the key. The dialog closes after successful authentication. / オレンジ色のノードでAPIを選び、キーを登録します。認証に成功すると画面が閉じます。
3. Source analysis checks panel order, identities and dialogue ownership, then creates a coherent reference and shot instructions. Story-critical text is preserved; incidental existing marks may remain when that keeps people and the scene stable. / 元画像のコマ順・人物・話者と台詞を検査し、一続きの参照画像と各カットの指示を作ります。物語上重要な文字は維持し、人物や場面の安定に役立つ既存の軽微な表示は残す場合があります。
4. Review original text, spoken reading and estimated duration before H3 generation. / H3生成前に原文・発音用の読み・推定尺を確認します。
5. The sampler generates and inspects each segment, with bounded repairs, then adds title and ending credit. / 区間ごとに生成・検査・上限付き修正を行い、最後にタイトルと終了クレジットを付けます。

## Timing and cuts / 尺とカット
One complete speaking turn per shot; the total is the sum of confirmed 5–15 second windows. Only silent stories use the 30-second fallback. / 1ショットに完全な台詞を1つ配置し、確定した5〜15秒の区間を合計します。30秒の既定尺は台詞がない場合だけです。
The default review permits light compression where needed. Select original-preservation mode to retain exact source wording. Timing estimates are not measured speech durations. / 既定の読み確認では必要な箇所の軽い要約を許容します。原文を守る場合は原文保持モードを選びます。推定時間は実音声の測定値ではありません。
Each planned cut changes the camera angle and spatial perspective. A zoom or crop alone is insufficient. Keep each line complete before cutting. / カットではカメラの角度と遠近感を変えます。ズームや切り抜きだけで別カットにせず、台詞と語尾を残してから切り替えます。

## Models and audio / モデルと音声
Video: Fused Turbo, Res Multistep, Simple, 4 steps; SLA sparsity 0.9, block 64, audio protection enabled. / 映像はFused Turbo・Res Multistep・Simple・4ステップ。SLAはsparsity 0.9、block 64、音声保護ONです。
The sampler exposes audio refinement steps and denoise separately from video steps. Audio refinement uses 4 steps and denoise 1.0 when needed. / 音声の再精錬ステップとdenoiseは映像とは別に設定し、必要な区間へ4ステップ・denoise 1.0を適用します。
H3 generates dialogue, restrained effects and ambience without music. The workflow generates one continuous score for the full variable duration and mixes it after all accepted clips, so the BGM does not restart at each cut. / H3は台詞・控えめな効果音・環境音をBGMなしで生成します。合格区間の後に可変尺全体の通しBGMを1曲生成して自動合成し、カットごとのBGM再開始を防ぎます。

## Cloud prompt / クラウド用プロンプト
The rightmost node displays the completed prompt and reveals the copy button when ready. Select the whole video or an individual clip. / 右端のノードに生成済みプロンプトを表示し、準備ができるとコピーボタンを表示します。全体または区間を選べます。
For the whole video, attach image_01.png onward in order. For each clip, use its clip_XX_reference.png when exported: it contains only that shot’s verified cast. / 全体はimage_01.png以降を順に添付します。区間別は、その場面の人物だけを検証したclip_XX_reference.pngがあれば、その画像を使います。 No automatic upload; other services may produce different video, titles and credits. / 自動送信はしません。他サービスでは映像・タイトル・クレジットの結果が異なります。

## Setup and privacy / 導入と保存
Required: ComfyUI-NanoBanana-H3, ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Long-Video, ComfyUI-PlagueKind-Nodes, and the configured model/VAEs/CLIP. This non-LM workflow does not require LM Studio. / 上記3パッケージと設定済みのモデル・VAE・CLIPが必要です。この非LM版にLM Studioは不要です。
The model loaders reference local files; review their original licenses before redistribution. No model files or new distribution ZIP are included here. / モデルローダーはローカルのファイルを参照します。再配布時は各原典のライセンスを確認してください。モデル本体や新規の配布ZIPは含みません。
API keys live in server memory only and disappear on restart. They are never stored in the workflow. / APIキーはサーバーのメモリだけで保持し、再起動すると消えます。ワークフローには保存しません。
Personal readings: ComfyUI/user/default/nanobanana_h3/pronunciation_dictionary.json. Never include them in public packages. / 個人の読みは左記に保存し、公開用パッケージへ含めません。
Final MP4: ComfyUI/output/video/MiniMax_H3/. Intermediate segments and audits: the sampler's cache folder under ComfyUI/output/h3_long_video/. / 完成MP4と区間・検査記録はそれぞれ左記へ保存します。ファイル名は日時で識別します。

## Validation / 検証
Validated on 2026-09-20 through the normal source-analysis, reading-review, generation, inspection/repair and save path: 6 accepted segments, 33 seconds, 864×480 at 24 fps. A cut-off line failed inspection; its complete counterpart and a naturally finished short line passed. 270 regression tests passed. / 2026-09-20に元画像解析・読み確認・生成・検査修正・保存の通常経路で実生成し、6区間・33秒・864×480・24fpsで合格しました。語尾切れ音声は不合格、完全な音声と自然に終わる短い台詞は合格することを実検査し、回帰テスト270件も通過しました。
This validates the tested cases, not every future input. Inspection retains rejected attempts and may still need human review for subtle voice or editing judgments. / 検証した入力での結果であり、今後すべての入力で成功する保証ではありません。不合格候補の記録を保持し、微妙な声や演出は人の確認が必要な場合があります。

You author a MiniMax H3 Ref2VA prompt from an original Japanese manga and its clean scene reference. Return the complete prompt only. This is the source-authoring stage of a reusable variable-duration workflow.

SOURCE, CAST AND STORY
Read every source panel and speech balloon in the actual Japanese reading order: panel order first, then right-to-left/top-to-bottom within each panel. Preserve all source speaking turns, owners, causal order, emotional progression and punchline. Preserve each source line verbatim, including particles and punctuation. Never merge two speakers, omit a turn, invent speech, or shorten words during this stage. The supplied verified inventory determines entity IDs and dialogue ownership: E1 is Subject 1, E2 is Subject 2, and so on; speaking labels belong to those entities, not the order of speaking turns. Repeated drawings of one identity remain one entity.
In subject definitions include only stable physical features and voice identity. Keep panel-specific actions, expressions and prop changes inside their own Shot, not in global identity prose. Define only source-evidenced characters and story-critical objects. Preserve distinct hair, face, clothing, attachments, apparent age, and each character's stable voice. Infer pitch, timbre, speaking style and emotion from the actual character; avoid a universal voice. Preserve source-panel cast membership; a definition is not a demand to put every character into every shot. Describe exactly the visible people and their positions for the current source beat. No clones, duplicated bodies, transferred hairstyles, merged identities or invented people. Background crowds remain background crowds. Preserve important object counts and ownership when meaningful to the story; do not turn every minor prop difference into an identity change.

REFERENCE AND PUBLICATION TEXT
The original manga is for source analysis. Only the transformed single coherent scene is the active H3 reference, <Picture 1>. Do not feed the manga grid or a multi-view character sheet as the video reference. Do not invent additional Pictures, Videos or Audios. Preserve the source's identity and art style using the clean reference; it does not lock every shot to the reference camera position.
Remove comic borders, gutters, speech balloons, dialogue captions and publication overlays. Preserve exact printed text only when the verified inventory marks it as story-critical. Text whose meaning is already spoken in dialogue is explanatory, not story-critical, and must not become an entity or required visible subject. A short confirmation stamp or mark that only finalizes, repeats or punctuates a spoken punchline is also dialogue-redundant; do not stage its stamp, placard or signboard as a video subject, even if a preliminary inventory called the mark important. Even approved story-critical writing must stay on its source-supported physical object at a natural scale and position; never relocate it into a corner inset, explanation card or overlay. Do not deliberately add or emphasize other lettering. Natural existing product marks, name-tags and background signs may remain when preserving them protects character, object, audio and scene stability. Never render screen-relative text: no subtitles, captions, explanatory cards, corner boxes, watermarks, URLs, credits, labels, banners or interface graphics. Allowed writing must remain attached to its source-supported physical object at natural scale and scene perspective; never move, enlarge or repeat it as an overlay. Never generate a title, subtitles, credits or URL; the workflow adds the title and fixed ending credit after generation.
Read the publication title separately from dialogue, author names and URLs. Start with exactly overlay_title: "the source title". If no title is legible after reinspection, use overlay_title: "無題". This line is metadata and never an instruction to render text.

[FOURPANEL CONFIRMED DIALOGUE FIT]
AUTO-DURATION DIALOGUE PACKING
This workflow separates source extraction from final speech fitting.
For THIS authoring output preserve every source dialogue exactly and its verified owner/order.
Write exactly ONE Shot block per speaking turn, with exactly ONE complete <d>[Japanese] source line</d> in that Shot. Thus the number of Shot blocks equals the number of source speaking turns, without an arbitrary cap. A panel with two turns has two shots; it must not be collapsed into one shot with two lines.
Use [Shot 1] with no timestamp. Each following source turn N begins with [Shot N] At MM:SS.mmm, at (N-1)*5 seconds. These five-second anchors are provisional source coordinates only. Do not put numeric total durations, end deadlines or fixed-window claims in summaries, prose or Global Instructions. The subsequent reading review decides permitted light compression versus original preservation and assigns individual 5-to-15-second windows, then retimes the anchors. Never rush, clip, split or repeat a line to satisfy a former total duration. All reactions stay within their turn's Shot, not additional silent Shot blocks. When the source has no speech, preserve the full visual story with the workflow's 30-second fallback and no invented dialogue.

CAMERA AND PERFORMANCE
The opening shot establishes the source location and current people. For every later dialogue shot, start the first descriptive sentence with 'Cut to ' and specify a concrete new camera setup: height, angle, the active speaker's screen position, foreground and background perspective. After that camera opening, add a standalone 'Visible subjects: <Subject N>, ...' line. List exactly the inventory entities whose panels include this dialogue's original source panel, including its identity-critical objects. The actual scene prose must match that list. Do not show the complete group reference cast in every shot. Compare it with the preceding shot: a tighter crop, zoom, pan or unchanged camera axis alone does not constitute a new angle. Choose a natural viewpoint change such as an eye-level over-the-shoulder view following an elevated two-shot. The changed view must be present from the first frame of the new shot; never replay the prior camera view or its dialogue as an introduction.
Keep the conversational axis, eyelines, location, subject identities and action continuity. The active speaking face must remain readable and unobstructed. Frame listeners naturally from behind, in profile, partly occluded or at a subordinate distance when that helps bind the voice, without inventing a second copy of a person. Preserve all required source characters; a foreground shoulder is the existing listener.
Within each shot use one restrained continuous lateral track or gentle arc only when compatible with clear speech; avoid rapid zooms, spins, shakes, focus loss or multiple competing routes. Specify the start and settled composition and meaningful foreground/background perspective. Keep the shot continuous until its entire line and natural reaction finish. No mid-line or internal cuts. The next Shot boundary alone introduces the next angle.
Animate the actual scene, not a static manga image sliding under the camera. Give the active speaker one clear story-supported verb-object action with start, action and settled pose. Add a subordinate independent change such as the listener's brow/head/hand response, moving clothing or handled object. Keep identities, limbs and important props consistent. Express comic or dramatic emotion with appropriate delivery rather than forcing every voice calm or subdued.

SPEECH AND SOUND
Immediately before each <d> block state the correct <Subject N> (Sx), its distinctive visible identity, screen position, action, emotion and stable voice quality. Only that speaker articulates the line. Listeners remain silent with closed lips and react through eyes, brows, head, posture and hands. Do not assign the line to a reacting face. Each line occurs once, in Japanese, with natural articulation and breath. Retain normal source orthography here; the separate reading review owns pronunciation changes. No invented narration, additional words, overlapping voices, repeated clauses or sung dialogue. A music symbol in source dialogue indicates expressive delivery, not an instruction to repeat or sing the line.
Speech is dominant and dry, without artificial doubling, echo or chorus. Keep room ambience and story-matched physical sounds restrained. H3 generates dialogue, restrained physical sound and room ambience only; request no music inside individual clips. The workflow separately generates one continuous instrumental score for the full fitted duration, ducks it under speech and mixes it once after all shots are joined. No vocals, spoken samples, choir or voice-like lead in that external score. Let the final line and a natural silent reaction finish before the video ends; the subsequent timing stage supplies the real deadlines.

OUTPUT FORMAT
First line: overlay_title: "..."
Then exactly these six English sections in order:
subject_definitions: Define each verified source entity once; include stable (Sx) and voice for speakers, and <Picture 1> as the clean reference.
summary: Begin with [reference generation]. Describe the 16:9 story, source-panel order, variable dialogue-fitted duration without a numeric total, one-reference use, speech priority, external title/credits and one separately generated continuous BGM track.
retention_analysis: For the reference and each subject use fully_preserved, partially_preserved, attribute_transfer or weak_reference as actually appropriate. Identity retention applies when visible, not a universal visibility requirement.
detailed_description: Brief visual style and the required per-turn Shot blocks, using the camera, performance and exact dialogue rules above.
overall_soundscape: Low ambience and restrained physical sounds, with intelligible emotionally appropriate speech dominant.
non_diegetic_music: State that H3 clip music is absent and describe the separately generated continuous instrumental score.
Finally one [Global Instructions] paragraph preserving identities, voices, source order, one complete line per shot, distinct camera setups, silent listeners, scene continuity, text-removal policy and dialogue-fitted timing. No numerical duration claims.
Output plain text, no markdown fences, links, explanations or alternative versions. Before returning, count source turns and Shot blocks, compare every line/owner, and verify every following Shot begins with a genuinely different 'Cut to' camera setup.

nodes.title: 3. Nano Banana変換指示（単一フレーム化・重要文字と安定性を両立）
widgets_values:
Create exactly one clean 16:9 full-bleed cinematic animation keyframe from the supplied four-panel manga page.

Preserve the story-critical characters, their identities, clothing, facial features, emotions, key props, setting, and the panel sequence's visual intent. Combine the source into one coherent live-action-style anime scene suitable as the single <Picture 1> reference for MiniMax H3. Resolve repeated drawings of the same person as one stable identity, render each intended visible person exactly once, and render each story-critical countable prop in the required count. The result is one continuous scene, never a multi-view character sheet or repeated-character montage.

Remove every comic panel border, gutter, page margin, speech balloon, balloon tail, dialogue caption, sound-effect lettering and publication overlay. Reconstruct those removed areas as natural coherent environment, lighting, furniture, floor, crowd or prop detail. Preserve exact printed text only when the verified inventory marks it as story-critical. Text already conveyed by dialogue is explanatory and must not be recreated as a placard, inset, text box or required prop.
